questions.q: Why must reading be done in the name of the Lord?
options: Many read but gain no guidance because they read without bismillah
questions.explain: Bismillah distinguishes reading that receives mercy from reading that does not.

questions.q: Why was the Prophet's SAW being ummi an advantage?
options: It is proof that the revelation was not copied from people
questions.explain: The Prophet SAW did not read or write, so the revelation was not his composition.
Rabb is a name that carries many meanings.

options: A clinging clot in the womb
questions.explain: An alaq is like a leech that clings.

questions.q: How far did the Prophet SAW run home to Khadijah?
questions.explain: He came home with a pounding heart and asked to be covered.

questions.q: What did Khadijah do when the Prophet SAW came home afraid?
options: Covered him without questions, then listened to his story

questions.q: Even the bravest man may tremble and need to be calmed.
questions.explain: True. Do not belittle a man in a moment of weakness.

questions.q: Wealth can breed self-sufficiency until one feels no need for God.
questions.explain: True. That was the state of Quraysh.

questions.q: Put these events in the right order.
questions.explain: Jibril came, he ran home, Khadijah calmed him, Waraqah confirmed, then Waraqah died and revelation paused.

questions.q: Match each term with its meaning.

right.text: The truth, referring to the Quran or Jibril
The keeper of secrets, referring to Jibril

questions.explain: Bismillah is in the name of Allah, sunnatullah is the laws of nature, al-haqq is the truth, and namus refers to Jibril.

questions.q: You are looking for a life partner. What example does the Prophet SAW give on the night of revelation?
options: A partner who calms and accepts without judging
questions.explain: The Prophet SAW ran to a wife who accepted without judging.
